places.quote: At last we came into the narrow streets of Deal, and very gloomy they were upon a raw misty morning.
rolling away seaward with the Kentish letters
places.note: Adjective form; the mail carried letters for Kent.

places.quote: We all went to London that afternoon, and finding two places in the mail, secured them.
places.note: Also mentioned as the destination of the coach passing from Deal-bound landscape.

places.quote: I have a father to support in the Vale of Taunton

places.normalized: The Downs, anchorage off Deal, Kent
places.quote: I don’t know how many sail the waiter told us were then lying in the downs.
places.note: Sheltered sea anchorage, not a river; lowercase in text.
